verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a public API reference for Identity Verification, including the /identity_verification/retry endpoint, plus registrable webhooks (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) and a Sandbox with custom test users, so programmatic control is clearly supported. Coverage of the full product surface is not shown: the user flow runs through the client-side Link UI, flow editing is a no-code Dashboard editor, failure overrides are documented via the Dashboard, and OpenAPI probes returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of API endpoints for creating, getting and listing verification sessions, API-level control of templates/workflows and overrides, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: /identity_verification/retry | Allow a user to retry an identity verification
You can select which events you want to subscribe to. For Identity Verification, there are three events: STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED
Plaid supports creating custom test users from your organization directly in Sandbox.
